title: Adelaide Crows v Brisbane Lions
location: Adelaide Oval, War Memorial Drive, North Adelaide
description: The 2027 AFL Gather Round opens with a deafening roar at Adelaide Oval as the Adelaide Crows host the reigning powerhouse Brisbane Lions under Thursday night lights.
transport_tips: Free Footy Express bus, train, and tram travel included with match ticket. City stops at King William St and Adelaide Railway Station.

title: Collingwood v Sydney Swans
location: Adelaide Oval, War Memorial Drive, North Adelaide
description: Massive Friday night interstate clash between the Magpie Army and the Sydney Swans. Expect a sellout Adelaide Oval atmosphere with over 50,000 passionate fans.
transport_tips: Take the Riverbank Footbridge from Adelaide Railway Station. Free travel on Adelaide Metro with your game day ticket.

title: Gold Coast SUNS v GWS GIANTS
location: Barossa Park, Lyndoch Recreation Park, Lyndoch
description: Saturday lunchtime action in the picturesque Barossa Valley wine region. The SUNS and GIANTS battle amidst rolling vineyards, gourmet food stalls, and boutique wine tastings.
transport_tips: Dedicated Barossa Express shuttle coaches depart Adelaide Central Bus Station and Gawler Station. Pre-booking seat reservation recommended.

title: Carlton v Melbourne
location: Adelaide Oval, War Memorial Drive, North Adelaide
round_info: Traditional Victorian Rivalry on Neutral Soil
description: Carlton and Melbourne bring their storied Victorian rivalry to South Australia. The Carlton cheersquad takes over the Riverbank Stand while the red-and-blue faithful fill the Eastern Terrace.
transport_tips: Adelaide Metro Footy Express operates all morning. Gates open at 11:30am ACST.

title: Richmond v West Coast Eagles
location: Norwood Oval (Coopers Stadium), The Parade, Norwood
round_info: Suburban Heritage Showcase on The Parade
description: Suburban footy romance at its finest! Richmond takes on West Coast under the historic Norwood Oval lights, with fan precincts stretching all the way down vibrant retail strip The Parade.
transport_tips: Special Footy Express Norwood shuttle buses run continuously along Grenfell St & The Parade.

title: Fremantle v Hawthorn
location: Adelaide Oval, War Memorial Drive, North Adelaide
description: High-octane Saturday night football at Adelaide Oval. Fremantle's purple army and Hawthorn's brown-and-gold clash in a crucial top-eight Gather Round battle.
transport_tips: Arrive early to catch the post-match light and sound spectacular over the River Torrens.

title: Essendon v North Melbourne
location: Norwood Oval (Coopers Stadium), The Parade, Norwood
description: Old-school Sunday lunchtime footy on The Parade. Bombers fans and Roos supporters pack the iconic Michael Taylor stand and boundary lines for an intimate suburban grudge match.
transport_tips: Free park-and-ride shuttles from Adelaide CBD Victoria Square straight to Norwood Oval.

title: Geelong Cats v St Kilda
location: Barossa Park, Lyndoch Recreation Park, Lyndoch
description: Geelong meets St Kilda in a premier country setting at Lyndoch. Enjoy world-class regional hospitality, Barossa shiraz, local produce, and elite AFL action in SA's premier wine country.
transport_tips: Footy Express Barossa shuttles link directly with Gawler railway line services.

title: Port Adelaide v Western Bulldogs
location: Adelaide Oval, War Memorial Drive, North Adelaide
description: The curtain comes down on Gather Round 2027 with Port Adelaide defending their home deck against the Western Bulldogs. Expect 50,000 voices singing 'Never Tear Us Apart' at bounce time.
transport_tips: Extra post-match outbound trains and trams run from Adelaide Railway Station until midnight.

title: AFL Gather Round 18-Club Players Parade
location: King William Street to Adelaide Oval Riverbank
description: The inaugural Gather Round Players Parade! Captains, star players, and mascots from all 18 AFL clubs march down King William Street across the bridge into Elder Park.
highlights: Open-top vehicle parade, live marching bands, club mascots, and massive public player signing sessions.

title: Elder Park Footy Festival & Live Site
location: Elder Park, King William Road, Adelaide Riverbank
description: The central four-day festival hub on the banks of the River Torrens. Giant outdoor broadcast screens, AFL player appearances, merchandise superstores, South Australian food trucks, and live music.
highlights: Free admission, interactive AFL Skills Zone, craft beer garden, and nightly fireworks display.

title: Barossa Food & Wine Footy Village
location: Tanunda Town Square & Murray Street, Tanunda
description: Post-match Saturday celebration in Tanunda! Showcasing world-renowned Barossa wineries, artisanal distillers, woodfired pizzas, and live acoustic bands after the Lyndoch games.
highlights: Meet AFL club ambassadors, regional tasting flights, and dedicated return shuttles to Adelaide CBD.

title: Richmond & West Coast Junior Auskick & Captain's Run
location: Norwood Oval (Coopers Stadium), The Parade, Norwood
description: Open training captain's run followed by an interactive Auskick super-clinic on the pristine turf of Norwood Oval. Kids get to meet players, collect autographs, and take selfies.
highlights: Free entry for juniors, giveaways, kicking masterclass with senior coaches.

title: Geelong Cats & St Kilda Seaside Junior Clinic
location: Glenelg Oval (ACH Group Stadium), Brighton Road, Glenelg
description: Seaside morning footy clinic at iconic Glenelg Oval. Geelong and St Kilda stars run junior drills covering marking, tackling safety, and goal-kicking accuracy.
highlights: Auskick showbags, team posters, and Glenelg beach precinct food discount vouchers.

title: Port Adelaide & Western Bulldogs Community Auskick Clinic
location: Alberton Oval, Queen Street, Alberton
description: Community clinic on the sacred turf of Alberton Oval. Includes AFL and AFLW player workshops, inflatable agility obstacle course, and museum tours.
highlights: Free BBQ sausage sizzle, skills certificate for all participating children.

title: Sydney Swans & Collingwood Family Footy Clinic
location: Prospect Oval, Menzies Crescent, Prospect
description: Sunday morning family football clinic at the historic home of North Adelaide. Swans and Magpies stars guide young footballers through fun drills and match simulations.
highlights: Full squad signing session, team merchandise prizes, and Roosters canteen open.

title: Carlton & Melbourne Auskick Masterclass
location: Unley Oval, Trimmer Terrace, Unley
description: Junior footy masterclass under the shady gum trees of Unley Oval. Focus on midfield ground-ball pickups, ruck craft, and goal celebrations with AFL role models.
highlights: Autograph cards, junior footballs, and Sturt FC heritage pavilion access.

title: Collingwood Magpies Official Supporter HQ
location: The Strathmore Hotel, 129 North Terrace, Adelaide CBD
description: The Magpie Army takes over North Terrace! Direct walk across the footbridge to Adelaide Oval. Balcony bar, live DJ, chant sessions, and pre-game hype with interstate cheersquad.
highlights: Magpie parmigianas, pints of local craft ale, guest appearance by past premiership heroes.

title: Cathedral Hotel: Lions & Cats Fan Gathering
location: The Cathedral Hotel, 45 Church Hill / Pennington Terrace, North Adelaide
description: Right in the shadow of St Peter's Cathedral and 200m from Adelaide Oval's northern gate. The Cathedral Hotel is the meeting ground for Brisbane Lions and Geelong fans.
highlights: Heritage beer garden, giant screens, live acoustic music, and traditional SA Coopers on tap.

title: The Austral: Carlton Blues Cheersquad Base
location: The Austral Hotel, 205 Rundle Street, Adelaide CBD
description: Rundle Street's iconic pub transformed into Navy Blue headquarters. Pre-game brunch, loud chorus of 'We are the Navy Blues', and group march to Adelaide Oval.
highlights: Classic Adelaide pub vibes, outdoor street parklet seating, Carlton banner photo ops.

title: The Lion Hotel: Melbourne Demons & Hawthorn Gathering
location: The Lion Hotel, 161 Melbourne Street, North Adelaide
description: Premier North Adelaide venue hosting Melbourne Demons and Hawthorn Hawks supporters. Renowned dining, South Australian wine list, and post-match live panel discussions.
highlights: Gourmet dining, private courtyards, sports screens showing interstate broadcasts.

title: The Alma Tavern: Richmond & Essendon Norwood HQ
location: The Alma Tavern, 66 Magill Road, Norwood
description: The eastern suburbs' favourite party tavern! Richmond and Essendon fans pack the expansive beer garden for pre-match BBQs before strolling down to Norwood Oval.
highlights: Massive outdoor LED screen, live DJ sets, match ticket food & drink specials.

title: The Lord Lyndoch: Barossa Matchday Footy Pub
location: The Lord Lyndoch, 23 Barossa Valley Way, Lyndoch
description: Just 500 meters from the Barossa Park match venue! The epicentre for pre-game drinks, schnitzels, and local Barossa wine for fans heading into the Lyndoch oval.
highlights: Country hospitality, shaded beer garden, live acoustic sets, walking distance to stadium gates.

title: The Tanunda Hotel: Footy & Shiraz Hub
location: The Tanunda Hotel, 51 Murray Street, Tanunda
description: Historic grand heritage pub in the centre of Tanunda. Gather Round headquarters for wine-loving footy fans with live sports lounge and regional craft taps.
highlights: Barossa butcher steaks, local wine pairings, shuttle stop at front door.

title: Payneham FC Footy Legends Speaker Night
location: Payneham Football Clubrooms, Roseneath Reserve, Payneham
description: An unfiltered grassroots evening of footy storytelling! Former SANFL champions and AFL cult heroes share hilarious changeroom tales, infamous tribunal disputes, and Gather Round insights over cold beers.
highlights: Memorabilia auction, Q&A with special guests, classic suburban clubroom hospitality.

title: Adelaide Footy League Showcase: Uni Blacks v PHOS Camden
location: University Oval, Mackinnon Parade, North Adelaide
description: Experience pure grassroots passion in the Adelaide Footy League Division 1 showcase clash. Pure suburban footy under the North Adelaide plane trees with boundary-side deckchairs and a sizzle.
highlights: Free admission, can bar, community raffle, traditional halftime kick-to-kick on the oval.

title: Live Footy Podcast Extravaganza at The Arkaba
location: The Arkaba Hotel (Top of the Ark), 150 Glen Osmond Road, Fullarton
description: Live, uncensored post-match footy podcast show! Leading independent footy commentators and comedians break down the Friday night blockbuster with audience banter and hot takes.
highlights: Live stage recording, audience trivia, drink specials, late night DJ.

title: SANFLW Showcase: West Adelaide v Norwood
location: Thebarton Oval, 1 Meyer Street, Torrensville
description: Top-tier women's state league football at historic Thebarton Oval. Blood 'n' Tars clash with the Redlegs in a fierce traditional rivalry featuring tomorrow's AFLW superstars.
highlights: Historic grandstand viewing, canteen pasties, community atmosphere.

title: Barossa, Light & Gawler League Showcase: Tanunda v Nuriootpa
location: Tanunda Recreation Park, Elizabeth Street, Tanunda
description: Authentic country football rivalry at its fiercest! The Magpies and Tigers collide in the Barossa's oldest grudge match. Cars parked around the boundary line honking their horns for goals.
highlights: Barossa butcher burgers, boundary car-parking, local winemakers' marquee.
